title: The Kite That Shook in a Clear Sky
central_conflict: the festival kite vibrated violently despite a steady breeze
decisive_choice: a newly attached decorative tail oscillated at the same rhythm as the kite frame
resolution: replaced the tail with a balanced design and tested the kite in a clear area
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered the festival kite vibrated violently despite a steady breeze before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but the flyers shortened the main string but the shaking did not stop; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a newly attached decorative tail oscillated at the same rhythm as the kite frame; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they replaced the tail with a balanced design and tested the kite in a clear area, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: Rain-Damaged Lantern
central_conflict: their lantern had gone dark just before the evening procession
decisive_choice: a narrow crack around the glass cover was letting in the rain
resolution: sealed the crack with resin and carried the relit lantern to the procession
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered their lantern had gone dark just before the evening procession before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.

With the visiting readers watching, they sealed the crack with resin and carried the relit lantern to the procession, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: Missing Storybook
central_conflict: the children's storybook had vanished from its wooden box
decisive_choice: a scrap of matching ribbon was caught beneath a loose bench
resolution: lifted the bench together and returned the book before story time
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the children's storybook had vanished from its wooden box before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they searched the reading tent, but only an empty ribbon was left behind; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a scrap of matching ribbon was caught beneath a loose bench; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they lifted the bench together and returned the book before story time, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
